name: holdvue
author: HoldVue contributors
description: Local-first portfolio observation shell for macOS and Windows

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include='src/**/*.ts' --include='src/**/*.cts' --include='dist/preload.cjs' --exclude='src/**/*.d.ts' --exclude='src/shared/ports.ts' --check-coverage --lines=100 --branches=100 --functions=100 --statements=100 --reporter=text node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run coverage && npm run build
scripts.package:mac: npm run check && npm run icons && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never && npm run smoke:package -- release/mac-universal/HoldVue.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run check && npm run icons && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never && npm run smoke:package -- release/mac/HoldVue.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run check && npm run icons && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && npm run smoke:package -- release/mac-arm64/HoldVue.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar
scripts.package:win: npm run check && npm run icons && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run smoke:package -- release/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar
